## Self-Review Checklist

- [ ] Build passes (`dotnet build` / `npm run build`)
- [ ] All tests pass including the new regression test
- [ ] No commented-out code or debug artifacts
- [ ] Secrets, credentials, and PII not included
- [ ] Root cause is documented above
- [ ] Regression test covers the specific failure path
- [ ] Migration scripts (if any) are idempotent
